caption: 174 likes, 4 comments - crlscrew on June 11, 2026: "10th at Head of the Charles, 3rd at Regionals, 4th at NEIRA, 1st at States (x2), and now 10th in the time trial at Nationals. 28 likes, 0 comments - crlscrew on May 24, 2026: "Today is the day. MPSRA (Mass Publics), our State Championships and the last regatta of our spring season. Sunday May 24 in Lowell.
